en.description:
The best Sudoku puzzle game built exclusively for Apple Watch.

Train your brain anywhere - no iPhone needed. Watch Sudoku brings the classic number puzzle game straight to your wrist, designed from the ground up for the Apple Watch experience.

---------------------------------------------------------

THREE GRID SIZES
- 4×4 - Quick puzzle, perfect for a 1-minute break
- 6×6 - Medium challenge, great for focus
- 9×9 - Classic Sudoku, full brain workout on your wrist

THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
- Easy, Medium, Hard - pick your challenge

BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH
- Digital Crown support - scroll to select numbers instantly
- Haptic feedback on every move
- Clean, minimal interface optimized for small screens
- Offline - no Wi-Fi, no iPhone required

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- Daily streak to build a puzzle habit
---------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO PLAY
Tap any empty cell. Scroll the Digital Crown or tap +/− to pick a number. Tap Place to fill the cell. Fill every row, column, and box without repeating numbers.

---------------------------------------------------------

PREMIUM - ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Upgrade once, play forever.
- Unlimited games
- 6×6 and 9×9 grids
- Hint system (reveal one cell)
---------------------------------------------------------

Watch Sudoku is the only Sudoku app you need on your Apple Watch. Whether you have 1 minute or 10, there is always a puzzle waiting on your wrist.

Download now and start your streak.
